🔄 How We Scale Your Store

Our E-Commerce Growth Process

We replace guesswork with a systematic, data-backed optimization protocol designed to systematically boost ROAS and revenue.

01

Store Audit

We analyze your website loading speed, pixel attribution, GMC feed, checkout leaks, and past ad campaigns to find quick-win opportunities.

02

Competitor Research

We analyze competing ads, catalog price models, landing pages, and search keyword gaps to map out an acquisition strategy.

03

Audience Research

We segment your past customers, build lookalikes, study interest groups, and set up dynamic remarketing targets.

04

Feed Optimization

We restructure product feed metadata to maximize matching with Google Shopping and Performance Max algorithms.

05

Campaign Setup

We deploy clean campaign structures separating cold acquisition from catalog retargeting, utilizing certified parameters.

06

Conversion Tracking

We establish server-side tracking (Meta CAPI & GA4) to guarantee zero loss of conversion data in browser environments.

07

Ad Optimization

We perform weekly asset, keyword, bid, and budget adjustments to systematically lower CPA and increase ROAS.

08

Scaling & Reporting

We allocate more budget to winning campaigns, launch retention flows, and deliver live Looker Studio reporting.

❓ FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our e-commerce growth and advertising management services.

Our pricing is customized based on your store's current size, monthly ad spend, and growth goals. We offer flexible packages including retainer models, performance-based models, and combined models. Contact us for a custom proposal after we conduct your free store audit.
While we work with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, and custom builds, Shopify is generally the easiest to scale due to its native integrations with Meta, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and major shipping providers. However, we optimize and scale stores on any platform.
ROAS stands for Return on Ad Spend. It measures the gross revenue generated for every rupee spent on advertising (Revenue / Ad Spend). For example, a 5x ROAS means that for every ₹1,000 spent on ads, your store generates ₹5,000 in sales. It is the primary metric we optimize to ensure your ads are highly profitable.
Performance Max is a goal-based campaign type in Google Ads that allows advertisers to access all Google Ads inventory (Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, and Google Maps) from a single campaign. We use advanced audience signals, conversion tracking, and high-quality creative assets to make PMax highly profitable for online stores.
Typically, conversion tracking fixes and search/shopping campaign setups yield immediate search visibility improvements within 7-14 days. Performance scaling and consistent ROAS improvements usually require 30 to 90 days as Google's AI and Meta's pixel learn your customer buying patterns.
Yes, we are Shopify growth experts. We manage everything from Shopify SEO (speed optimization, metadata, schema markup, product feed sync) to paid ad setups, app integrations, and custom checkout CRO strategies.
Absolutely. WooCommerce stores often require specialized technical SEO and speed optimization to handle high traffic. We set up WP-Rocket, optimize product databases, build XML feeds, and integrate WooCommerce with Klaviyo and GA4.
Yes, product feed management is critical for Google Shopping success. We optimize product titles, descriptions, custom labels, Google product categories, and resolve Google Merchant Center suspensions or disapproved items.
Yes, driving traffic is only half the battle. We conduct comprehensive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) audits, set up heatmaps, optimize checkout flows, design high-converting product pages, and implement cart abandonment recovery systems to turn more visitors into buyers.
We run highly profitable campaigns on Google (Shopping, Search, PMax, YouTube), Meta (Facebook & Instagram Shopping), Pinterest, and marketplace networks like Amazon Ads depending on where your target audience searches.
We design and deploy automated retention sequences ('flows') in Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or Omnisend. These include Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart Recovery, Browse Abandonment, Win-back campaigns, and VIP customer loyalty rewards.
We implement advanced server-side tracking using Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and Google Tag Manager server-side containers. This bypasses browser ad-blockers and iOS privacy updates to provide 100% accurate data attribution.
Yes, we manage enterprise-level Magento (Adobe Commerce) marketing campaigns. Magento stores benefit greatly from our technical SEO audits, custom XML feed builders, and advanced search filters optimization.
AOV is Average Order Value. We increase your AOV by implementing smart product bundling, automated cross-sell/upsell widgets at checkout, free shipping thresholds, and volume discounts.
Yes, our certified experts optimize your accounts weekly (bids, keywords, negative matches, ad creatives). We provide a live, transparent Looker Studio dashboard so you can monitor sales, spend, and ROAS in real-time, plus we host weekly sync calls.
We work on rolling monthly agreements as we believe in keeping our clients through excellent results, not lock-in contracts. However, we recommend a minimum window of 3 months to fully optimize campaigns and establish a baseline ROAS.
